items.title: Introducing upgrades to Codex
items.summary: Codex just got faster, more reliable, and better at real-time collaboration and tackling tasks independently anywhere you develop—whether via the terminal, IDE, web, or even your phone.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI对Codex进行了性能升级，提升了其响应速度与可靠性。此次更新增强了模型在终端、IDE及移动端等多种开发环境下的实时协作能力，支持开发者更独立地完成复杂编程任务。原始信息显示：Codex just got faster, more reliable, and better at real-time collaboration and tackling tasks independently anywhere you develop—whether via the terminal, IDE, web, or even your phone.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing upgrades to Codex”。其重要性主要体现在：Codex的性能升级直接影响开发者的编程效率与AI辅助编码工具的实用性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.title: How people are using ChatGPT
items.summary: New research from the largest study of ChatGPT use shows how the tool creates economic value through both personal and professional use. Adoption is broadening beyond early users, closing gaps and making AI a part of everyday life.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布研究报告，分析了ChatGPT在个人与专业领域的经济价值及普及情况，显示AI应用正逐渐融入日常生活。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容为市场调研报告，缺乏大模型技术演进或具体应用落地的技术细节。

items.title: Addendum to GPT-5 system card: GPT-5-Codex
items.summary: This addendum to the GPT-5 system card shares a new model: GPT-5-Codex, a version of GPT-5 further optimized for agentic coding in Codex. GPT-5-Codex adjusts its thinking effort more dynamically based on task complexity, responding quickly to simple conversational queries or small tasks, while independently working for longer on more complex tasks.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布GPT-5-Codex模型，专门针对智能体编程任务进行优化。该模型核心创新在于引入了动态推理机制，能够根据任务复杂度自动调整计算资源分配。对于简单查询，模型可快速响应；而面对复杂编程任务，模型则能进行长时间的独立思考与执行，显著提升了智能体在复杂开发场景下的自主性与任务完成质量，是AI辅助编程领域的重要技术突破。

aiReview.reasonZh: GPT-5-Codex引入了动态推理能力，是智能体技术在编程领域的重要演进。
